hypothesis.observed_symptom: Control deck taps out on own turn with counterspell in hand, leaves no untapped mana for opponent's priority window
hypothesis.failing_test_rule: control deck holds mana for counter when reactive-only card in hand

input.conventions: Tests live in tests/test_<rule>.py and use the session `card_db` fixture; a test builds a GameState directly, names cards only as fixture carriers, and asserts the mechanic. Red before the fix, green after.

expected.rule_name: control deck holds mana for counter when reactive-only card in hand
expected.fixture_setup: Build a game on the control player's main phase: untapped lands equal to a reactive-only counterspell's cost plus one more mana, the counterspell in hand, and a sorcery-speed permanent spell castable only by tapping the mana the counter needs. Opponent has threats in library and an empty board.
expected.assertion: The main-phase decision does not cast the sorcery-speed spell that would tap below the counterspell's cost; enough untapped mana to cast the reactive-only card remains at end of turn.
